from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "traefik_access_log")
  // Point to the pre-calculated count field
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "OriginContentSize_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "$Host")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["RouterName"] == "$RouterName")
  |> fill(column: "browser", value: "None")
  |> group(columns: ["browser"], mode: "by")
  // Divide the 30-second bucket by 30 to get RPS
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 30.0 }))
  // Average the rates over the Grafana view window
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(column: "_value", value: 0.0)

import "experimental"

from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: experimental.subDuration(d: v.windowPeriod, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: experimental.addDuration(d: v.windowPeriod, to: v.timeRangeStop))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "traefik_access_log")  
  // 1. Point to the pre-calculated sum field instead of raw sizes
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "OriginContentSize_sum")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "$Host")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["RouterName"] == "$RouterName")
  // 2. Ungroup everything to create a single total line
  |> group()
  // 3. Sum the 30s Telegraf buckets into the Grafana view window
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, column: "_value", createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(value: 0.0)
  // 4. Convert to Kilobytes
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1.0/1000.0}))
  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "Sent")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "Sent"])
